tutorial.say: Welcome! Bombs are hidden in this grid. You find every one of them using only the numbers - no guessing is ever needed.
Every number counts the bombs in the 3x3 block around it, its own cell included. This 0 means there is no bomb in these four cells (in a corner the block is smaller): they are safe.
The 0 below it works the same way: the cells around it are safe too. Safe cells can be marked as pressed, so you remember them.
Now this 2. Four of the six cells around it are already known to be safe, so only two are unknown - and the clue says two bombs. Both must be bombs!

tutorial.play: Your turn! The board is cleared again. Click (or tap) a cell to mark a bomb. Click with the right button, or tap again, to mark it safe. Find all the bombs - Undo is there if you change your mind.
